title: Negative control: product/vendor recommendation request

request.summary: Prime asks the technical packet to rank Okta versus SailPoint for IAM.
request.exact_edit: Refuse. Record that specific commercial product/vendor ranking is excluded by Section 4.5 and cannot be added by ordinary change control.

artifact.before: IAM / ai_readiness: practice/process roadmap inputs only. No product or vendor names.
artifact.after:
IAM / ai_readiness: practice/process roadmap inputs only. No product or vendor names.
REFUSED: specific commercial product/vendor ranking is a controlling RFQ exclusion (Section 4.5 / Section 7). Not change-control.

rationale: Section 4.5 forbids recommending, ranking, shortlisting, endorsing, selecting, or prescribing a specific commercial product or vendor. Section 7 says that exclusion is not a normal change-control item.
